question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

Marcella seemed **__morose__** and downcast when she refused to have dinner.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Gloomy**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the underlined word '**Morose**' is '**Gloomy**'.
 
• **Morose**: "**Morose**" is an adjective that describes a person who is sullen, sad, and not cheerful. In Hindi, it can be translated as*** "उदास" or "अवसादी"***.
 
 
• *Example: The team was in a **morose** mood after losing the championship game.*
 
 
 
• **Gloomy**: The word "**gloomy**" means dark, dim, or depressing. In Hindi, it can be translated as*** "उदास" or "अंधेरा".*** 
 
 
• *Example: Sarah's face looked **gloomy** and sad when she heard the bad news about her grandfather.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__*** Gloomy.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• "**Jocund**" - This means cheerful or merry. In Hindi, it can be translated as "खुशमिजाज" or "प्रफुल्लित".
 
• "**Excited**" - This means feeling or showing enthusiasm or eagerness. In Hindi, it can be translated as "उत्साहित" or "उत्कंठित".
 
• "**Liberal**" - This means open to new behavior or opinions and willing to discard traditional values. In Hindi, it can be translated as "उदार" or "आजाद-ख्याली".
